notes: Two additions to per-user access control (Administration > Users): 1) Each of the five main sections (Translation, Free Service Gateway, Giveaway, Telegram Channel, SEO) now has three independent toggles instead of one - View (see the lists, read-only), Edit (translate, confirm, mark rewarded, create/edit/delete records, etc.), and Settings (that section's own settings page) - so a user can, say, see the Giveaway queue without being able to mark claims as rewarded, or manage Telegram posts without touching its settings. General Settings keeps View + Settings (no Edit tier - nothing there fits it). Existing users' old single-toggle grants were not automatically migrated to the new tiers - re-check and re-grant access for any non-super-admin users on the Users page after installing this. 2) New Administration > Activity Log: records who changed what and when across the panel - data edits (create/update/delete) on URLs, languages, gateway services/servers/blocked IPs, and users, plus specific actions like marking a claim rewarded, confirming/rejecting a Telegram post, and installing a panel update, plus every login/logout. Super-admin only, filterable by user/section/date. Requires 'Update database' after installing this update.
